# Características de las series temporales

```{r}
library(fpp3)
```

```{r}
PBS |>
  filter(ATC2 == "A10") |>
  select(Month, Concession, Type, Cost) |>
  summarise(TotalC = sum(Cost)) |>
  mutate(Cost = TotalC / 1e6) -> a10
```

```{r}
a10 |>
  features(Cost, list(mediana = median)) |>
  arrange(mediana)

a10 |> features(Cost, quantile)
```

```{r}
a10 |> features(Cost, feat_acf)
```

```{r}
tourism |>
  features(Trips, feat_stl) %>% summarise(max_valor = max(trend_strength, na.rm = TRUE))



```

```{r}
tourism |>
  features(Trips, feat_stl) %>% summarise(max_valor = max(seasonal_strength_year, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
tourism |>
  features(Trips, feat_stl) |>
  filter(
    seasonal_strength_year == max(seasonal_strength_year)
  )|>
  left_join(tourism, by = c("State", "Region", "Purpose"), multiple = "all") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Quarter, y = Trips)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(vars(State, Region, Purpose)) +
  labs(x = "Trimestre")

```

```{r}
tourism |>
  features(Trips, feat_stl) %>% summarise(min_val = min(seasonal_trough_year , na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
tourism |>
  features(Trips, feat_stl) |>
  filter(
    spikiness  == max(spikiness )
  )
```

linearity

```{r}
tourism |>
  features(Trips, feat_stl) %>% summarise(max_val = max(linearity , na.rm = TRUE))

tourism |>
  features(Trips, feat_stl) |>
  filter(
    linearity  == max(linearity)
  )

```

```{r}
tourism |>
  features(Trips, feat_stl) %>% summarise(max_val = max(curvature , na.rm = TRUE))
```

curvature

```{r}
tourism |>
  features(Trips, feat_stl) |>
  filter(
    curvature  == max(curvature)
  )
```
